name: Mood Journal
description: A simple mood journaling extension — record mood, notes, tags; view history; export or clear entries. Data stored locally.

data_collected: User settings (daily reminder preference and time).
data_collection_permissions.purpose: Store user mood journal entries locally to review history, export, and receive optional daily reminders.
data_collection_permissions.third_party_sharing: None. All data is stored locally unless user explicitly exports it.
data_collection_permissions.user_control: Users can view, export, and delete entries; they can enable/disable reminders and clear settings.
